An '''Imperial holotable''' was a large, round [[Holotable/Legends|holotable]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The polished black table featured a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] globe at its center for displaying tactical maps and messages.<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> It had room for twelve chairs,<ref name="DSTC">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref> with comlinks and intercom devices installed around the edges of the table.<ref name="BTM" /> The [[Death Star conference room/Legends|Death Star conference room]] featured one of these holotables.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
